name: Beijing Zhongke WengeAI Science and Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Zhongke WengeAI Science and Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2017 and based in Beijing, develops full-stack enterprise AI infrastructure in China and Hong Kong. Its products include the DIP AI data platform, the YAYI enterprise foundation model, the ScienceOne scientific foundation model, the Claworks agent operating system and the Decitron decision-support system. It serves public sector, media and communications, and commercial customers.
